newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine forex deposits up in June at $16.8 bln.
newsitem.headline: Philippine forex deposits up in June at $16.8 bln.

text.p: The Philippine banking system's foreign currency deposits reached a record $16.8 billion at the end of June, the Philippine Central Bank said on Thursday.
This is 6.3 percent higher than the previous month's level of $15.8 billion and a 44 percent increase from the year-earlier $11.7 billion.
The Central Bank said these foreign currency deposits are considered a second layer of international reserves. These come from local exporters and earnings of overseas Filipinos.
